_notes: Fixed/curated boss loot for The Broodspiral (home-brew 3->4-boss silithid dungeon, Kyle's ask 2026-09-11). Same mechanism as data/loot/sunken_grotto_boss_loot.json - read by entities/boss_loot.py's get_fixed_boss_loot(), one random item per boss kill from its own pool, not all at once. Every stat/armor/damage number computed from the REAL formulas in entities/loot_generator.py (STAT_BUDGET_BASE_MULT=0.36, weight_tiers, armor_types.json's armor_multiplier, stat_budget_costs from gear_suffixes.json) at 'rare' rarity (1.7x) - not hand-guessed. Kyle's explicit ask: 'dungeon loot can be slightly higher than standard rares' - item_level is boss_level+3 throughout (no existing multiplier precedent for a dungeon bonus elsewhere in the loot system, so this follows real WoW's own convention of dungeon-drop item level sitting a few points above the mobs guarding it, rather than inventing a new constant). Stat combos deliberately pull from gear_suffixes.json's REAL named suffixes ('of the Archmage', 'of the Tactician', 'of the Champion', etc.) rather than defaulting to flat single-template splits - Kyle's explicit pushback: 'why is everything int/spirit and agi/stam' - every item mixes a primary stat with a genuine secondary (spell_power, healing_power, attack_power, crit, hit, haste, defense, mp5), and no two items repeat the same combo. Secondary-stat amounts are budget divided by that stat's real cost from stat_budget_costs (e.g. crit/hit cost 10.0, haste costs 12.0, spell_power/healing_power cost 1.25) - NOT an equal split - matching how _roll_stats() actually works, which is why fractional amounts like 0.3% crit appear at this item level exactly like the rest of the game's gear does. NO trinkets per Kyle's explicit call (save that slot's rarity for later/special drops). Two weapons included per Kyle's ask: a gun (Larval Broodguard) and a 1H mace (Broodspiral Queen) - the gun deliberately carries Intellect/Healing Power instead of the procedural generator's hardcoded gun->agi_physical-only constraint (data/items/weapon_types.json's valid_stat_templates), because Kyle flagged that rigidity as actively hurting the CoA custom classes' weapon options; hand-authored loot bypasses generate_weapon() entirely (same as every item in this file bypasses the procedural path), so there's no code constraint being violated, just a deliberately wider design choice for this one drop.

Carapace Warden.name: Cracked Carapace Mantle
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: Still faintly warm from the kill that cracked it loose.

Carapace Warden.name: Warden's Chitin Bands
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: The chitin hums faintly when magic is drawn through it.

Carapace Warden.name: Burrower's Girdle
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: Segmented plating, flexible enough to strike from any angle.

The Broodkeeper.name: Broodkeeper's Vestments
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Stained deep green with the ichor of a thousand hatchlings.

The Broodkeeper.name: Caustic-Woven Leggings
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Woven from silk that dissolves anything but the wearer's own skin.

The Broodkeeper.name: Chitinguard Gauntlets
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Fused from carapace plates too thick for anything but a smith's press.

Larval Broodguard.name: Venomspitter Rifle
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: Fires a distilled venom round that somehow, impossibly, mends flesh instead of rotting it.

Larval Broodguard.name: Screenwarden's Helm
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: Every dent tells you it stopped something it wasn't supposed to survive.

Larval Broodguard.name: Broodguard's Signet
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: A ring of chitin, still faintly slick with venom that never dries.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Queen's Bulwark
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Taken from the Queen's own throne-shell. It has never once cracked.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Hivemind Legguards
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Wearing them, you can almost hear the hive's thoughts. Almost.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Queenmother's Mace
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Grown, not forged - a spur torn living from the Queen's own foreleg.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Broodspiral Cloak
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Spun from the Queen's own molt. It still moves like something alive.
